honestyNote: Each bullet maps to NAMED executable witnesses with the commit that landed them. Coverage is per target: local-dev-sqlite-ibex (the gate-2 substrate arm) and cloudflare-do-sqlite-v8 (a narrow proof, not gate-bearing — LLP 0076 author decision 7). The gate-bearing hosted receipt on single-instance-container-vm.v1 exists as of 2026-07-25 (results/remote-streaming.v0.json, 7/7 on the Fly.io drill target under the recorded SNAPBACK_PROFILE=test --allow-insecure-dev-auth posture behind the platform TLS edge — protocol amendment v0.7). That receipt closes the hosted-receipt gap only; it claims no hosted-auth capability and does not by itself close gate 2 while this authority is Draft and the staged-work ledger has open items.

bullets.bullet: a deterministic server sends 16 numbered UTF-8 chunks over at least 800 ms

witnesses.witness: instrument check '16 upstream chunks become multiple authoritative native-push commits' (sourceChunks 16, sourceDurationMsMinimum 800)

bullets.bullet: a second client observes at least three authoritative intermediate commits before terminal completion

witnesses.witness: same instrument check: second-client observer over native-websocket-push records 8 intermediate authoritative commits, fallback off

bullets.bullet: the received bytes are ordered, complete, and never duplicated across an idempotent retry

witnesses.witness: instrument checks 2 (ordered complete body) and 3 ('reply start retries are idempotent and cross-user progress mutation is refused')
egress check 'the Workerd action isolate pulls the complete response through ctx.fetchStream' (totalBytes exact, ordered checksum)

bullets.bullet: slow consumption keeps application buffering within 64 KiB

witnesses.witness: lib test slow_consumer_buffering_stays_within_the_profile_bound_across_four_cursors (real high-water counter, four cursors, peak <= 64 KiB, accounting released to zero)

structural only: one-in-flight-pull refusal + per-chunk ceiling + invocation-wide carry-over refusal path; 16 KiB visible-chunk cap witnessed by egress check; no high-water counter witness (internals unobservable through real workerd)

bullets.bullet: total-byte, idle, wall-clock, and progress-rate limits fail with their exact codes

witnesses.witness: lib tests bounded_action_stream_refuses_the_first_byte_past_the_total_limit, bounded_action_stream_enforces_wall_idle_and_progress_rate_codes, wall_ceiling_bounds_a_blocked_read_absolutely (mid-read absolute wall)

egress checks: 1 MiB total refusal, exact idle-timeout code, SNAPBACK_ACTION_PROGRESS_RATE_EXCEEDED nested-mutation fence; the 30 s wall is race-enforced but not separately witnessed there (no wall manifest row is published)

bullets.bullet: explicit cancellation closes the upstream reader and prevents every late progress commit

witnesses.witness: instrument check 'durable cancellation stops the reader and fences every late patch' (latePatches 0) + lib test cancel_physically_closes_the_upstream_socket_of_an_indefinite_source (physical close observed by the fixture)
egress check 'response-stream cancellation is idempotent and makes the reader terminal'

bullets.bullet: failed, cancelled, timed-out, and ambiguous attempts remain distinct

witnesses.witness: instrument checks 4/5/6 (cancelled; timed_out; failed-vs-ambiguous under the decision-5 safe-method-only downgrade) + lib test keyed_non_get_transport_loss_settles_ambiguous_and_pre_send_failures_stay_failed

bullets.bullet: a cancelled-after-initiation and a timed-out-after-initiation attempt each carry the upstream-effect-may-have-executed fact, while a pre-initiation failed attempt does not

witnesses.witness: instrument check 7 'terminal rows mirror the host-derived effect certainty' (cancelled/timed_out/ambiguous all true through the authored mirror, protocol v0.5) + lib tests cancelled_and_timed_out_after_initiation_carry_the_effect_fact and keyed_non_get_... (pre-send failure carries no uncertainty) + stream_attempt_rows_survive_process_death_and_reconcile_conservatively (crash fold)

bullets.bullet: reload/reset, authority loss, and watchdog abandonment close cursors and preserve the existing late-mutation fence

witnesses.witness: lib tests terminalization_during_read_discards_late_bytes_and_closes_the_cursor (generation fence mid-blocked-read), service_principal_terminalization_fences_stream_open_and_discards_late_bytes (real scoped-token authority + real terminal gate), watchdog_abandonment_terminalizes_stream_attempts_with_timed_out, detached_action_rejects_every_host_call_after_reload_or_reset

pre/post-pull abandonment revalidation with late-byte discard is implemented and exercised within the egress suite's action lifecycle; the abandonment signal is the complete predicate on this target (hosted auth unavailable)

host-ops dispatch refuses action.streamOpen outside action mode (SNAPBACK_ACTION_CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE); exercised by the shared bridge in the egress suite's query/mutation denial checks

explicitGaps.detail: No receipt exists on single-instance-container-vm.v1, the LLP 0075-selected hosted target that gate 2 requires (LLP 0076 author decision 7). Cloudflare remains a narrow proof and is not gate-bearing. LLP 0074 gate 2 stays open until that receipt exists.
explicitGaps.resolved: 2026-07-25 — the receipt exists: results/remote-streaming.v0.json, 7/7 PASS on the Fly.io drill target (app snapback-drill, machine 819701c927ee68, sjc; protocol amendment v0.7), with the durable-row scan (durable-row-scan.v0.json PASS), the Tigris backup read-back witness (tigris-backup.v0.json PASS), and the hosted-auth refusal witness (hosted-auth-refusal.v0.json — SNAPBACK_AUTH_DEPLOYMENT_UNSUPPORTED; no hosted-auth capability claimed). Posture caveat recorded in the receipt: SNAPBACK_PROFILE=test with --allow-insecure-dev-auth behind Fly's TLS edge. This resolves the receipt gap. Gate 2 closed 2026-07-25: this authority was Accepted (author ratification, Charlie Cheever) and the registry flipped bounded_response_stream_v1 to stable as the acceptance act; the ledger's scoped residues (OQ 6-7, the Workerd arm's narrower witness) stay recorded in the RFC.

explicitGaps.detail: Whether bounded_response_stream_v1 carries an explicit proposed/experimental maturity marker while LLP 0076 is Draft is the author's open LLP 0058 decision (issues/20260723-llp0076-capability-honesty.md). These receipts do not preempt it.
explicitGaps.resolved: 2026-07-24 — decided (Charlie Cheever) and implemented: LLP 0058 §Capability maturity adds the code-owned proposed/experimental/stable dimension, served manifests annotate bounded_response_stream_v1 experimental via capabilityMaturity, and admission requires the artifact's acknowledgedExperimentalCapabilities entry on both arms; the honesty ticket is closed (issues/closed/).

explicitGaps.detail: On cloudflare-do-sqlite-v8 the 30 s wall and the 64 KiB high-water accounting are structural (race-bounded read; refusal-path accounting) rather than separately witnessed; stated in that target's manifest runtime fact.
